items.title: Death Mountain summit
items.hint: At the summit, left of the owl, bomb the cracked wall. Play Zelda's Lullaby on the mark by the pool and offer 25 rupees for the Magic Meter and Din's Fire.
items.remakeNote: Remake swap: Din's Fire now comes from this fountain, along with the Magic Meter. In the original this fairy gave the Spin Attack upgrade.

items.title: Hyrule Castle grounds
items.hint: As a child, bomb the boulder at the dead end past the castle guards. Play Zelda's Lullaby and offer 50 rupees for the upgraded Spin Attack.
items.remakeNote: Remake swap: this fairy now grants the stronger Spin Attack. In the original she taught Din's Fire.

items.title: Zora's Fountain
items.hint: Bomb the cracked wall at the back of the fountain, behind Lord Jabu-Jabu. Play Zelda's Lullaby and offer 100 rupees for Farore's Wind.

items.title: Death Mountain Crater
items.needs: Megaton Hammer, Goron Tunic, 200 Rupees offering
items.hint: As an adult, smash the rocks on the west side of the crater with the Megaton Hammer (bring the Goron Tunic for the heat). Offer 200 rupees for a doubled Magic Meter.

items.title: Desert Colossus
items.hint: Bomb the cracked rock between the two palm trees near the Spirit Temple. Offer 300 rupees for Nayru's Love.

items.title: Outside Ganon's Castle
items.hint: At the far end of the grounds outside Ganon's Castle, lift the huge pillar with the Golden Gauntlets (found inside the castle). Offer 500 rupees for Double Defense — every hit deals half damage.
